title: Genesee Press group lifecycle: retire unused application groups
purpose: Synthetic demo policy of the fictional company Genesee Press. It decides when an Okta application group and its Active Directory counterpart may be put to a named human for retirement: no sign-in through the group in 90 days, an exact identity mapping, an empty and unnested AD group, no other application assignment, complete dependency checks, and current evidence. It never authorizes a change: every step is approved by different people, and this build only plans dry runs (D8).
changes: First version of GP-LIFECYCLE-004 recorded in OGWA.
